blocking.title: A puppet rises against an overrun overlord and goes free with no war: diploInvariants 20429 (1938, random diplomacy, 10 years) breaks rise on day 546 (DEI rose on NED and is not at war with it); the declaration is refused as Overrun after the release, the player reads "Dutch East Indies rose against Netherlands" and no war follows. Same on f464db35.
blocking.fix: puppets.ts handles only Allied/AlliedRealm before declareWar(world, n, o, true). Either a rising on an overrun overlord is not refused (as an overrun puppet is still declared on), or it is a release in name and law (PuppetReleased, "broke free") with the checker rule for rise changed in the same commit by an ADR. AT: diploInvariants 20429 random 3650: 0 broken; a unit case of a rising on an overlord with 3/4 of its land occupied: at war with it, or told released and not "rose against".
